versions.title: Brothers of the Orders

skins.name: Knight of Saint Lazarus
skins.story: Sworn to care for the sick as much as to fight, he wears the green cross of Saint Lazarus on black over blackened mail.

skins.name: Sword Brother
skins.story: He holds a stone fort on the cold northern frontier, the red sword and cross of his brotherhood on a white tabard.

skins.name: Knight of Mountjoy
skins.story: A knight of the small Order of Mountjoy, named for the hill where pilgrims first see Jerusalem, in a red surcoat with a white cross and heraldic shoulder plates.

versions.note: Three more military orders ride to the Holy Land: the black-clad Knights of Saint Lazarus, the Sword Brothers of the far north and the Knights of Mountjoy in their red surcoats.

versions.title: Sergeants of the Walls

skins.name: Crossbow Sergeant
skins.story: From under his iron kettle hat he has watched every siege on these walls, a quiver of bolts at his hip and a crossbow on his back.

skins.name: Turcopole Archer
skins.story: A light horse archer who rides scout for the orders, his pointed helm wrapped in olive cloth and a full quiver across his back.

skins.name: Banner Sergeant
skins.story: Wherever his black-and-white banner still flies, the knights know where to rally, so he has sworn never to let it fall.

versions.note: Knights win the charge, but the walls are held by sergeants: a crossbowman in a kettle hat, a turcopole archer and the sergeant who carries the black-and-white banner.

versions.title: Riders of the East

skins.name: Mamluk Lancer
skins.story: Trained from boyhood to fight from the saddle, he rides in steel lamellar laced with yellow silk, his face hidden behind a mail aventail.

skins.name: Steppe Horse Archer
skins.story: He can loose three arrows before his horse lands a single stride, and his fur-trimmed cap is the last thing his enemies see.

skins.name: Citadel Guard
skins.story: He keeps the gate of the old citadel in gilded scales and a white turban wound round a steel spike, and no one has passed him uninvited.

versions.note: From the other side of the battlefield come three new riders: a lancer in lamellar armour, a horse archer of the steppe and a guard of the citadel in gilded scales.
